description: Las Vegas, NV—Republican congressional candidate and Nevada businessman Cody Whipple today announced the endorsement of former Nevada Lieutenant Governor Lorraine Hunt-Bono, one of the state’s most respected leaders and longtime advocates for small business, economic development, and working families. “Cody will be a strong voice for our working families and local business community,” said Hunt-Bono, […]
